title: Stale-blocker and stalled-queue detector: blocked rows whose blocker is resolved, research units queued but never dispatched, landed_unproven past due; surfaced to the manager + operator so nothing sits marked blocked
note: Operator 2026-10-10 (verbatim intent): the manager skill needs a mechanism that checks blocked items the same way soaks alert when done or needing attention; 'if most of the things here aren't actually blocked, then that's a problem that they were still marked as blocked and weren't put into a work queue'. MEASURED 2026-10-10: 7 blocked rows; 4 had resolved or retired blockers (PROP-EVIDENCE-2 on WORK-SYSTEM done; E8 on E5 observed; PROP-TERM/PROP-TRAIL/PROP-ETH superseded or breakout_1 retired), and ML-RESEARCH-W41 claimed 3 units 'running' that had last_dispatched_at null for 2 days. Existing manager_preflight.check_blocked_claims only checks a basis is stated, not whether the blocker still holds. Next lane after PROP-INVALIDATION-REST.
